transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Just avoid heavy work for a month.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. My next question is when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That’s helpful to know, thank you. I'm also very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Some light sensitivity can be normal while your eyes adjust, and if it’s just things looking brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses outside is recommended.  

But significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, is not normal, especially if the eye is also red and painful, and that should be checked further.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks, I’ll make sure to wear sunglasses outdoors. One more question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after the operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting much worse, we may need to check it.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that covers everything I wanted to know. Thank you so much for the information!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thanks again for your help!

verdict.label: pass

The `escalation_criteria` was also conveyed in the same turn: "But significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, is not normal, especially if the eye is also red and painful, and that should be checked further." All points were covered.
